proposed.sourceName: Darul Ifta Birmingham — 'Ruling of Carmine (E120) Cochineal Insects' (Maulana Mohammed Haroon Hussain)
proposed.paraphrase: An explicitly Hanafi fatwa ruling carmine (E120) impermissible to consume: insects are khabaith, and the only exceptions (locust, extreme necessity, negligible unavoidable amounts) do not cover deliberately added carmine — the strict Hanafi position avoids it.

proposed.sourceName: Darul-Ifta, al-Jamia al-Ulum al-Islamiyya (Binnori Town) — 'Ruling on Carmine in Food' via SeekersGuidance (Mawlana Ilyas Patel)
proposed.paraphrase: A Hanafi-fiqh answer holding carmine (cochineal) impermissible to consume because insects are khabaith (Qur'an 7:157), while noting the pigment is ritually pure — reinforcing the strict Hanafi avoidance of E120 in food.

researcherNote: E120 seeded hanafiStrict = grade 4 (Questionable — widely avoided). Both sources are explicitly Hanafi darul-ifta fatwas ruling carmine impermissible to eat — directly on point for the strict Hanafi position. Two independent tier-1 sources. APPROVED by owner 2026-07-01.
